if you haven't had a real bowel movement in days, this is for you. it gave me my life back.

i'm 64. i'd go a week, sometimes longer, with nothing. rabbit pellets at best. i stopped traveling, stopped eating normal meals, planned everything around being near a toilet.

my daughter found Lanural's Regularity Reset, i was skeptical because nothing ever worked. but within  a week i was going every day. actually going. fully empty.

no cramping. no dependency. i eat what i want again. i left the house yesterday and didn't think about my gut once.

read the reviews, then try it. there's a 60-day love it or its free guarantee
